project: VNC Input, Fullscreen UX, ROI Robustness
overview: Re-audit the current VNC stack (mobile iOS/Android + desktop agent Windows/Linux/macOS) after recent bug fixes, then deliver multi-touch trackpad pass-through, fullscreen keyboard/more menu controls, debug toggle, ROI robustness with fixed QUIC port policy, zoom clarity improvements, snap-to-100% zoom, and persistent mobile logs while preserving VNC/ROI invariants.
goals: Re-scan VNC input + ROI code paths in mobile and desktop to prevent regressions after recent fixes
Enable multi-finger trackpad gestures to reach the PC agent (pass-through where supported, defined fallbacks where not)
Provide full-screen keyboard input and a consistent 'More' menu in both portrait and landscape
Hide VNC debug view by default with an explicit toggle in full-screen
Harden ROI connectivity and enforce configured QUIC port without fallback
Improve perceived sharpness when zoomed by tuning ROI request behavior
Improve usability with zoom snap-to-100% and persistent mobile logs
nonGoals: Replacing the VNC protocol or changing the logical framebuffer size
Auto-selecting random ports when the configured port is busy
A full UI redesign outside the VNC view/controls
Adding new streaming transports beyond the existing VNC + ROI QUIC design
successMetrics: Multi-finger gestures work on macOS/Windows/Linux as specified (pass-through or fallback) without breaking single-pointer input
Keyboard input is available in full-screen portrait and landscape, and text is sent reliably
Debug panel is hidden by default and can be toggled from a full-screen More menu
ROI QUIC uses only the configured port and shows a clear startup error when busy
Zoom near 100% snaps cleanly to 1.0 and is discoverable
Mobile logs persist across sessions and are accessible/exportable
openQuestions: Which OS-native APIs will be used to inject multi-touch gestures on Windows/Linux, and what are the fallbacks if native injection is unavailable?
What maximum ROI tile detail/bandwidth is acceptable at high zoom on typical mobile networks?
What log retention policy (count/size/days) should be enforced by default?

stack.framework: Flutter (Dart) mobile client + Rust/Tauri desktop agent
stack.hosting: Local desktop agent with VNC over WebSocket and ROI over QUIC (Quinn)
stack.database: SQLite (mobile local storage via existing sqflite)

routes.name: VNC Session
routes.purpose: Primary VNC view with controls and trackpad

uiNotes: Fullscreen must have a 'More' button in both portrait and landscape with glass-style consistency
More menu must include: Keyboard input, Debug view toggle, Recalibrate cursor action
Debug panel is hidden by default; toggle controls visibility
Zoom controls should visibly snap to 100% when within a small threshold
Keyboard input UI should match existing VNC control styling (rounded, glass/overlay where appropriate)
rules: ROI overlay must not change logical framebuffer size or input mapping
ROI QUIC must bind only to the configured port; if unavailable, startup fails with error (no fallback)
Multi-finger gestures should be passed through to the OS/agent when supported; only use defined fallbacks when OS injection is unavailable
Fallbacks: two-finger scroll maps to mouse wheel; macOS three-finger swipe switches virtual desktops
Zoom snap-to-100% must not change existing min/max zoom bounds
Logging must be low-overhead and must not block rendering or input

stories.title: Re-audit VNC input + ROI code paths after recent fixes
stories.description: As a developer, I want a refreshed context doc of VNC input and ROI pipelines so new changes do not regress recent fixes.
acceptanceCriteria: Create docs/vnc_input_roi_context.md with a summary of current input/ROI pipelines and recent-fix-sensitive areas
Explicitly reference files reviewed in both mobile and desktop (including mobile/lib/main.dart, mobile/lib/vnc_client.dart, desktop/src/vnc.rs, desktop/src/server.rs, desktop/src/quic/mod.rs)
Document invariants: logical framebuffer size is authoritative for input; ROI is visual-only; configured QUIC port only
Example: The doc contains a scenario describing zoom=2.0 + edge pan and the expected ROI alignment behavior
Negative case: If any required invariant section is missing, the story is not accepted

stories.title: Add fullscreen More menu with keyboard + debug toggle
stories.description: As a user, I want a fullscreen More menu (portrait + landscape) to access keyboard input, debug toggle, and cursor recalibration.
acceptanceCriteria: Fullscreen portrait and landscape show a visible 'More' button consistent with existing glass/overlay styling
More menu includes: Keyboard input, Debug view toggle, and Recalibrate cursor action
Debug view is hidden by default on entry; toggle shows/hides it without leaving fullscreen
Keyboard input opens a text entry UI and sends text to the remote session
Example: In fullscreen landscape, tapping More -> Keyboard, sending 'hello' emits a VNC text send
Negative case: Entering fullscreen without toggling debug must not show the debug panel

stories.title: Trackpad long-press drag for left/right buttons
stories.description: As a user, I want long-press on left/right mouse buttons to enable drag operations from the trackpad.
acceptanceCriteria: Long-press on left button engages a continuous button-down state until release
Long-press on right button engages a continuous button-down state until release
Pointer movement while long-press is active moves the cursor with button held
Example: Long-press left, move pointer, release -> remote drag completes and button-up is sent
Negative case: A short tap still produces a single click and does not enter drag mode

stories.title: Capture multi-finger trackpad gestures on mobile and send to agent
stories.description: As a user, I want multi-finger trackpad gestures to be forwarded to the agent instead of being ignored.
acceptanceCriteria: When 2+ pointers are active on the trackpad surface, emit a new gesture input payload to the agent
Gesture payload includes: gestureType, fingerCount, phase (start/update/end), delta or scale, and timestamp
Single-pointer behavior (move/click) remains unchanged
Example: Two-finger scroll on the trackpad emits a gesture payload with fingerCount=2 and scroll delta
Negative case: Pinch gestures must not trigger pointer movement or unintended clicks

stories.title: Map gesture payloads to OS input on desktop agent
stories.description: As a user, I want the desktop agent to apply trackpad gestures to the OS (or fallbacks) reliably.
acceptanceCriteria: Desktop agent accepts the gesture payload and validates required fields
Two-finger scroll gestures map to mouse wheel scroll on all desktop platforms
macOS three-finger swipe triggers workspace switch when native injection is unavailable
Example: A two-finger scroll payload results in OS scroll movement without affecting pointer position
Negative case: Invalid gesture payloads return a structured error and do not inject input

stories.title: Enforce ROI QUIC configured port and improve error surfacing
stories.description: As a developer, I want ROI QUIC to use the configured port only and fail clearly on conflicts.
acceptanceCriteria: Desktop agent startup fails with a clear error if the configured ROI QUIC port is in use
No automatic port fallback or port mutation occurs when binding fails
Mobile displays ROI error state with the configured port and does not auto-update to a different port
Example: Configure ROI port 4242, occupy 4242, start agent -> error message references 4242
Negative case: Binding to port 0 or changing to an ephemeral port is not allowed

stories.title: Improve ROI clarity at high zoom without changing framebuffer mapping
stories.description: As a user, I want clearer text when zoomed in by improving ROI detail while keeping VNC mapping stable.
acceptanceCriteria: When zoom exceeds a defined threshold, ROI requests increase detail (e.g., tighter tile size or higher pixel density)
Logical framebuffer size and input mapping remain unchanged
ROI debug stats reflect increased tile detail (tile count/bytes) during high zoom
Example: At zoom=2.5, ROI tiles render noticeably sharper than base scaling
Negative case: Changing VNC session width/height to achieve clarity is not permitted

stories.title: Snap zoom to 100% near default
stories.description: As a user, I want the zoom control to snap to 100% when close to default for better usability.
acceptanceCriteria: Zoom values within 0.95–1.05 snap to exactly 1.0
Snap behavior is applied on commit/end of drag and is reflected in the UI badge
Example: Setting zoom to 1.03 results in 1.0 and shows 100%
Negative case: Setting zoom to 1.2 must not snap to 1.0

stories.title: Add persistent mobile logs for VNC/ROI/gesture issues
stories.description: As a user, I want persistent logs on mobile to diagnose VNC/ROI issues.
acceptanceCriteria: Store logs locally with level/category/sessionId and a retention cap
Provide a VNC Logs view to inspect entries and copy/export selected logs
Log entries include ROI connect/disconnect errors and gesture forwarding failures
Example: A failed ROI connection appears in the log list and can be copied
Negative case: When logging is disabled, new entries are not stored
